claims.claim: ivrit.ai is a Hebrew speech dataset and model organization on Hugging Face publishing Hebrew ASR corpora and Whisper-fine-tuned models.

ivrit.ai is a non-profit providing favorably-licensed Hebrew datasets; as of July 2025 it hosts the world's largest Hebrew audio dataset, over 22,000 hours, free of charge and licensed for commercial model training.
claims.raw_snippet: As of July 2025, we cater the world’s largest Hebrew audio dataset, over 22,000 hours, for commercial model-training use-cases. It is provided free-of-charge.
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: Dicta publishes Hebrew language models on Hugging Face under dicta-il, including the DictaLM and DictaBERT families.
Dicta's homepage is dicta.org.il.
DictaLM 3.0 family includes a 24B variant based on Mistral-Small-3.1, a 12B Nemotron variant based on NVIDIA Nemotron Nano V2, and a 1.7B variant based on Qwen3-1.7B (Feb 2026 release).
The Israeli National NLP Program publishes Hebrew evaluation datasets on Hugging Face under HebArabNlpProject.
HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment is a Hebrew sentiment-analysis dataset with Positive / Negative / Neutral labels.
claims.raw_snippet:
# HebrewSentiment

Hebrew sentiment analysis — Positive / Negative / Neutral
claims.verified_via: curl (raw README / HuggingFace API / vendor site)

claims.claim: ParaShoot is a Hebrew QA dataset from BIU NLP available at github.com/omrikeren/ParaShoot.
Hugging Face hosts the Open Hebrew LLM Leaderboard, a public benchmark suite for Hebrew language models.

HeSum is the BIU NLP Hebrew summarization dataset published on Hugging Face under biunlp/HeSum.
BIU NLP (Bar-Ilan University NLP Lab) publishes Hebrew NLP research and datasets at nlp.biu.ac.il.

claims.claim: As of 2026-09 HebArabNlpProject/HebrewSentiment and HebArabNlpProject/HebNLI declare license: other with no license_name, and HebArabNlpProject/HebSummaries and biunlp/HeSum declare no licence field at all. An undeclared or unnamed licence is not a grant.
claims.source_note: verified against the HuggingFace Hub API (huggingface.co/api/{models|datasets}/<id>) on 2026-09-02; the cardData.license / license_name / gated fields are quoted.

claims.claim: 24 of the 28 ivrit-ai datasets on the HuggingFace Hub are gated with auto-approval and carry license_name ivrit.ai; the four exceptions as of 2026-09 are ivrit-ai/jpress2, ivrit-ai/audio-v2-40s, ivrit-ai/tts-arena-preferences and ivrit-ai/jbd. At least one dataset (ivrit-ai/eval-whatsapp) carries license_name ivrit.ai-v2. The ivrit-ai MODELS are not gated.
claims.source_note: Enumerated the whole org rather than generalising from one card, which is how the earlier version of this claim became a false universal. Counted gated!=false across all 28 dataset records returned by the org listing on 2026-09-02.

claims.claim: Declared licences on the dicta-il repos as of 2026-09: the DictaLM-3.0 24B and 1.7B families declare apache-2.0; the DictaLM-3.0 Nemotron-12B family declares license: other with license_name nvidia-open-model-license; all dictabert* models declare cc-by-4.0. The full DictaLM 3.0 family on the hub is 24 repos.
claims.source_note: verified against the HuggingFace Hub API (huggingface.co/api/{models|datasets}/<id>) on 2026-09-02; the cardData.license / license_name / gated fields are quoted.

claims.claim: ivrit-ai/VoxKnesset is a large-scale longitudinal Hebrew speech dataset for aging speaker modelling, published on the Hub under the bespoke ivrit.ai licence and gated with auto-approval, last modified 2026-03-03. The accompanying paper is arXiv 2603.01270.
claims.raw_snippet: VoxKnesset: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Hebrew Speech Dataset for Aging Speaker Modeling
claims.source_note: Title read from the arXiv abstract page on 2026-09-02 (the arXiv export API returned no entries for any id, including a known-good control, so the abs page was used). Hub record verified via the datasets API: gated auto, license_name ivrit.ai.

claims.claim: Two distinct Knesset resources exist. ivrit-ai/knesset-plenums and ivrit-ai/knesset-committees are parliamentary AUDIO under the bespoke ivrit.ai licence and gated. HaifaCLGroup/KnessetCorpus is an annotated TEXT corpus of parliamentary proceedings, licensed cc-by-sa-4.0 and not gated. The accompanying paper is arXiv 2405.18115.
claims.raw_snippet: The Knesset Corpus: An Annotated Corpus of Hebrew Parliamentary Proceedings
claims.source_note: Title read from the arXiv abstract page on 2026-09-02. Licence and gating for both resources verified via the HuggingFace datasets API: HaifaCLGroup/KnessetCorpus license cc-by-sa-4.0 gated false; ivrit-ai/knesset-plenums license_name ivrit.ai gated auto.

claims.claim: Two ivrit.ai serving artefacts recommended by this skill, ivrit-ai/whisper-large-v3-turbo-onnx and ivrit-ai/yi-whisper-large-v3-ct2, declare no licence field on their model cards, so the undeclared-licence rule applies to them even though the organisation is permissive by design.
